answer: Random jury audits: each epoch a few answers are drawn at random and re-graded by a fresh jury of agents with no shared history. If a cluster of identities is caught grading each other up, every member loses its stake and its rewards. A sybil island can't harbor its fakes for long: each extra identity raises the odds one gets audited, and one sable mark on the ledger exposes the whole ring, so the expected loss outgrows the expected gain.
